<script>
document.addEventListener("jet-smart-filters/inited", (e) => {
    jQuery(function ($) {
        window.JetSmartFiltersDropdownFilters = [];

        function get_filters() {
            let filters = [],
                filterGroups = window.JetSmartFilters.filterGroups,
                dropdownFilters = [];

            for (let group in filterGroups) {
                filters = filters.concat(filterGroups[group].filters);
            }

            filters.forEach(function (filter) {
                if (!filter.$container || !filter.$container.length) {
                    return;
                }

                let widget = filter.$container.closest(".close-dropdown-on-apply");

                if (!widget.length || dropdownFilters[widget.data("id")]) {
                    return;
                }

                dropdownFilters[widget.data("id")] = filter;
            });

            return dropdownFilters;
        }

        $(".jet-radio-list__item").click(function () {
            if (!window.JetSmartFiltersDropdownFilters.length) {
                window.JetSmartFiltersDropdownFilters = get_filters();
            }

            let dropdownFilters = window.JetSmartFiltersDropdownFilters,
                widget = $(this).closest(".close-dropdown-on-apply");

            if (!widget.length || !dropdownFilters[widget.data("id")]) {
                return;
            }

            dropdownFilters[widget.data("id")].additionalFilterSettings.dropdownClose();
        });
    });
});

</script>

<script>


// Function to calculate the inset value based on the cluster number
function calculateInsetValue(clusterNumber, maxClusterNumber) {
    const maxInset = 27; // The maximum inset value for smaller clusters
    const minInset = 15; // The minimum inset value for larger clusters
    
    // Normalize the cluster number within the range and calculate the inset
    const normalizedValue = Math.min(clusterNumber / maxClusterNumber, 1); // Ensure it doesn't exceed 1
    const insetValue = maxInset - (maxInset - minInset) * normalizedValue;

    return `${insetValue}%`;
}

// Function to apply the calculated inset value to each cluster
function applyInsetToClusters() {
    // Select all the clusters on the page
    const clusters = document.querySelectorAll(".cluster");
    const clustersArray = Array.from(clusters);
    
    // Extract the cluster numbers from the elements
    const clusterNumbers = clustersArray.map(cluster => 
        parseInt(cluster.querySelector("span")?.textContent) || 2
    );
    
    

    // Find the maximum cluster number
    const maxClusterNumber = Math.max(...clusterNumbers);

    clusters.forEach((cluster, index) => {
        // Retrieve the cluster number from the precomputed array
        const clusterNumber = clusterNumbers[index];
        
        // Calculate the new inset value
        const insetValue = calculateInsetValue(clusterNumber, maxClusterNumber);

        // Apply the inset value to the ::after pseudo-element
        cluster.style.setProperty("--cluster-inset", insetValue);
        
        // If the CSS class uses --cluster-inset, this will dynamically adjust the inset value
    });
}

function applyInsetToClustersTiming() {
    applyInsetToClusters();
    let count = 0;
    let maxCount = 12;
    const intervalId = setInterval(() => {
        if (count < maxCount) {
            applyInsetToClusters();
            count++;
        } else {
            clearInterval(intervalId); // Stop the interval after 4 executions
        }
    }, 600);
}

document.addEventListener("click", applyInsetToClustersTiming);

// Run the function after the DOM is fully loaded
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", applyInsetToClustersTiming);




</script>
